newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa still vulnerable, may test support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa still vulnerable, may test support.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
London's benchmark September cocoa contract still looks vulnerable after two consecutive weak closes and may soon test psychological support at 1,000 stg a tonne, technical analysts said on Monday.
Traders called September cocoa to open three stg lower than Friday's close.
But with short-term momentum indicators weakening as prices tested lower levels, the market's technical outlook had turned more bearish, analysts said.
"I think it looks a bit vulnerable," said Adrian Haylor, an analyst at Sucden. "The 1,000 mark is major support and if it were to break you could potentially see a fairly big slide.
"The way it stands at the moment I believe it probably is going to test 1,000 support."
Short-term momentum indicators had recently turned lower and were now hovering in negative territory.
Haylor pegged initial resistance at last week's high of 1,052 stg followed by the 1,063 peak notched up just after the breakaway slide at the start of the month.

On the downside, once September managed to break through 1,000 it was likely to target a series of intra-day lows stretching back to early April, after which a small unfilled gap was seen between 989 and 1,010.
"That gap will probably be a target," said Haylor.
